problem_statement: Add Kokkos::Experimental::BadAlloc, derived from std::runtime_error, and export it in the Kokkos::Experimental namespace. Provide a constructor that takes the memory-space name, allocation size, and label, with corresponding const accessors. Its what() must include the memory-space name, a human-readable representation of the size, and the label. Update the library’s bad-allocation throw path to use BadAlloc instead of std::runtime_error so existing catch (std::runtime_error&) blocks remain compatible.
title: Introduce Experimental::BadAlloc exception type to throw on allocation failures
